in_marathi.name: Birendar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Mind or Conqueror of Senses
in_marathi.long_meaning: Birendar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Birendar is a Sanskrit name derived from two roots: 'Bira' meaning mind and 'Indra' meaning lord or conqueror. This name signifies the one who rules over the mind and senses. In Hindu mythology, Indra is the god of rain, thunder, and storms. The name Birendar is believed to be bestowed upon those who possess the courage and wisdom to control their thoughts and emotions.
